rules.activation: All presets off. EXPERIMENTAL / UNWITNESSED. Exact box-score starter identities do not establish snap-specific personnel, and shared files retain the chosen moment.
rules.appearance: Keep every appearance, height/weight, age, commentary/photo, contract and unknown bit. Name, jersey and exact main-table college index only may change.
rules.college: Keep an encodable nflverse college; when that CSV cell would be blank, use PFR college. Encode only an exact unique main-table string; retain the source college fact even when it cannot be encoded.
rules.editorial_qbs: Superseded by box-score starters. Original editorial_qb_preference fields retained for compatibility.
rules.fillers: Bench: prefer season-roster members ordered by games started, games, AV, name within the fixed retail position mix; then same-season nflverse, then closest-season same-franchise role fillers. All exceptions recorded.
rules.names: PFR display names for season-page members; exact/normalized or documented franchise-scoped familiar/legal-name aliases link the nflverse base. Existing 15-character codec, no truncation.
rules.numbers: Only the selected game-season PFR roster supplies numbers, exact name then normalized name. Blank or absent rows retain the retail number and are marked unknown. No other-season jersey inference.
rules.positions: Keep each retail slot code, rank, side and team pointer. Broader DB/LB/OL/RB/DL roles may fill compatible slots; all concessions listed per player.
rules.ratings: Keep all 28 retail rating/style bytes exactly. No Hall of Fame, All-Pro or Pro Bowl signal supplied; no adjustment. Native C1030 clamps ratings to 0..100.
rules.shared_seasons: Prefer a used moment matching file season; then calendar date year; then nearest season, lower moment index breaks ties. Unique files take their moment season. January/February belong to preceding season.
rules.starters: Reserve all 22 box-score starters first, using retail rank and side chains; extra TE/WR/DB starters take the next available depth in their role. Team names bind the box-score sides to SITU.
